evidence_summary: Audited 174k dense embeddings 15-year slice evaluation (years 2000-2014, 91,929 decisions). Three representations evaluated on frozen harness v3 (seed=42, exact k-NN, fixed stratified 2000-decision subsample): raw multilingual_e5_768dim, center_projected_768dim, center_projected_64dim. ALL THREE FAIL both adversarial gates (language dominance > 0.85 threshold, jurist pairwise preference < 0.5 threshold). Raw: LangDom=0.988, JP=0.0315. CP 768: LangDom=0.899, JP=0.267. CP 64: LangDom=0.894, JP=0.2825. Center projection improves JP 8-9x and reduces LangDom ~0.09, but neither crosses frozen thresholds. Methodology verified: frozen thresholds from evaluation_v3_config.json, exact k-NN backend, no holdout contamination, no benchmark gaming, honest FAIL reporting. Work correctly scoped as 'IN PROGRESS' per control plane. No repairs needed. Claim ceiling EXPLORATORY — intermediate slice evidence only; full 174k + metric learning needed for REPRODUCED/ACCEPTED.
